CHAPTER.VERS: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

And the earth was , and void;
and darkness was upon the face of the deep.
And God said, Let there be lighta note: and there was light. And God saw the light, that it was good: & God divided the light from the darkness.
Thus the heavens and the earth were finished.
This book claims to be Exodus (2) but says Matthew.

CHAPTER.CAPTION: The love of God
CHAPTER.VERS: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
